chapter_title: The World of Metals and Non-metals
core_summary: All 118 known elements are broadly categorized into metals and non-metals based on physical and chemical properties. Metals are generally hard, lustrous, malleable, ductile, sonorous, and excellent conductors of heat and electricity. Non-metals are dull, brittle, non-malleable, non-ductile, and poor conductors. Key exceptions include sodium/potassium (soft metals cut with a knife) and mercury (liquid metal at room temp). Metals burn in oxygen forming basic oxides, whereas non-metals form acidic oxides.
